$schema: Curated character/blader data. May be enriched by scripts/sync-characters.mjs.

characters.name: Gingka Hagane
characters.bio: The fiery-headed protagonist of the Metal Fight trilogy. Inherits Pegasus from his father Ryo and battles to defend the world from the Dark Nebula and Nemesis.

characters.name: Ryo Hagane
characters.bio: Gingka's father, the original Pegasus blader, and director of the WBBA. Also fights as the masked Phoenix wielding Burn Fireblaze.

characters.name: Ryuga
characters.bio: The forbidden left-spin blader. Cold, ruthless, and overwhelmingly powerful. Wields the L-Drago line and eventually parts ways with Gingka as a respected enemy.

characters.name: Kyoya Tategami
characters.bio: Gingka's main rival. Former Face Hunters leader turned Gan Gan Galaxy ace. His Leone series channels the king of the savanna's pride and force.

characters.name: Kenta Yumiya
characters.bio: Gingka's first friend in town. Underdog who grows from cheering on the sidelines into a Legendary Blader by Metal Fury.

characters.name: Tsubasa Otori
characters.bio: Stoic eagle blader and former WBBA spy. Quiet strategist who learns to balance his inner darkness through his bond with Eagle.

characters.name: Benkei Hanawa
characters.bio: Loud, loyal, originally Kyoya's lieutenant in the Face Hunters. Builds a niche around his beloved Bull-themed Beys.

characters.name: Hyoma
characters.bio: Gingka's childhood friend from Koma Village. Skilled traditional blader; mentors Gingka during the early Metal Fusion arc.

characters.name: Hikaru Hasama
characters.bio: Bey reporter and former competitive blader. Trains under the WBBA after a defining loss; calm, analytical, deeply loyal.

characters.name: Yu Tendo
characters.bio: Pint-sized prodigy. Former Dark Nebula recruit who joins Gan Gan Galaxy in Metal Masters. Cocky, candy-loving, genuinely lethal.

characters.name: Damian Hart
characters.bio: Sociopathic prodigy from the HD Academy. His three-headed Hell Kerbecs and theatrical battle style make him Metal Masters' breakout villain.

characters.name: Masamune Kadoya
characters.bio: Self-proclaimed "Number One Blader." Loud, brash, instantly likeable. Joins Gan Gan Galaxy after challenging Gingka and never quite stops bragging.

characters.name: Da Xiang Wang
characters.bio: Calm, principled leader of China's team Wang Hu Zhong. Master defender — Vulcan Horuseus is one of the toughest walls in the trilogy.

characters.name: Julian Konzern
characters.bio: European nobility and captain of Team Excalibur. Wields Gravity Perseus with the precision of a fencer — banned from many tournaments for sheer dominance.

characters.name: Reiji Mizuchi
characters.bio: Sadistic Beylin Temple blader. Treats opponents like prey — Poison Serpent's slow, taunting style mirrors Reiji's menace.

characters.name: Chris
characters.bio: Quiet mercenary blader of Metal Fury. A Legendary Blader who fights only for the highest bidder — until the threat of Nemesis forces a choice.

characters.name: Rago
characters.bio: The vessel of the dark god Nemesis and the trilogy's final antagonist. Wields Diablo Nemesis X:D — a Bey designed to break the rules of spin itself.

characters.name: Tetsuya Watarigani
characters.bio: Crab-themed early Metal Fusion antagonist. Loud, scheming, and surprisingly tactical with Storm Capricorne's tip-tricks.

characters.name: Faust
characters.bio: The Spiral Force arc's mecha-blader. Twisted Tempo's relentless stamina is engineered, not earned — until the boy beneath the machine resurfaces.

characters.name: Damure
characters.bio: HD Academy striker. Mercury Anubis's 85 track and XF tip make him the fastest blade Damian fields.

characters.name: Tobio Oike
characters.bio: Sniper-style Metal Fusion antagonist. Storm Capricorne's M145Q tip enables ledge-tipping precision shots — his Sniper Shot is iconic.

characters.name: Salhan
characters.bio: Cocky leader of Team Chandora — India's representative. Trained on the streets of Bombay; Flame Serpent's Burning Mirage is his signature.

characters.name: Mei-Mei
characters.bio: Cheerful Wang Hu Zhong support blader. Bandid Goreim's stamina build keeps her in fights longer than opponents expect.

characters.name: Aguma
characters.bio: Massive, principled blader of Metal Fury. Wields Death Quetzalcoatl as a Legendary Bey after parting from his earlier Scythe Kronos.

characters.name: Yuki Mizusawa
characters.bio: Astronomy prodigy and Legendary Blader of Metal Fury. Beat Lynx's tall TH170 track suits his careful, calculative style.

characters.name: Doji
characters.bio: Metal Fusion's main antagonist. Cold, calculating, theatrical. Wields Dark Wolf and orchestrates the Dark Nebula's hunt for L-Drago.

characters.name: Reiki Sodo
characters.bio: Dark Nebula recruit and Cyber Pegasus's blader. Mechanical, methodical, designed to emulate Pegasus's strengths without the heart.

characters.name: Teru Saotome
characters.bio: Dark Nebula blader of Earth Virgo. Calm, fastidious, uses ED145's defense ring to outlast attackers.

characters.name: Busujima
characters.bio: Brute-force Metal Fusion antagonist. Bakushin Susanow's smash attacks fit his blunt, no-nonsense style.

characters.name: Sophie
characters.bio: Team Excalibur's elegant tactician — France's representative. Tag-teams with Wales using Grand Cetus T125RS.

characters.name: Klaus
characters.bio: Team Excalibur's German powerhouse. Wields Grand Capricorn 145D — known for the fastest launch in the World Championships.

characters.name: Argo Garcia
characters.bio: Eldest of the Garcia siblings. Wields Killer Beafowl with theatrical menace; rules his team through fear.

characters.name: Chao Xin
characters.bio: Wang Hu Zhong's idol-blader and ladies' man. Poison Virgo's stamina build hides serious tournament chops.

characters.name: Chiyun Li
characters.bio: Wang Hu Zhong's serious, principled blader. Thermal Lacerta's WA130 track suits his sharp, calculated style.

characters.name: Nile
characters.bio: Africa's representative blader on Team Wild Fang. Egyptian-themed Vulcan Horuseus pairs falcon imagery with hammer-strike defense.

characters.name: Tithi
characters.bio: Energetic Legendary Blader of Mars. Death Quetzalcoatl's mesoamerican-feathered serpent design matches his playful but lethal style.

characters.name: Dynamis
characters.bio: Legendary Blader of Venus and keeper of the Mist Mountain shrine. Jade Jupiter's bidirectional design reflects his cosmic perspective.

characters.name: Johannes
characters.bio: Lyra-themed Metal Fury antagonist. Wields Beat Lynx — a tall, agile stamina build that fits his feline persona.

characters.name: Bao
characters.bio: Possessed Beylin Fang blader fighting under Nemesis's shadow. Hades Crown's FB tip mirrors his erratic, tortured rage.

characters.name: King
characters.bio: Brash, friendly Legendary Blader of Mars (alongside Aguma's Saturn). Variares's mode-change wheel matches his flexible, improv-driven combat.

characters.name: Zeo Abyss
characters.bio: Star Breaker recruit and former friend of Masamune & Toby. Flame Byxis's stamina build supports his calculated, manipulative style.
